headline.en: Read OFD documents from a command line.
headline.zh: 从命令行读取 OFD 文档。

sub.en: ofdcli opens OFD ZIP/XML containers and exposes text blocks and page boundaries as structured JSON.
sub.zh: ofdcli 打开 OFD ZIP/XML 容器，将文本块与页面边界输出为结构化 JSON。

body.en: Text blocks and coordinates are machine readable.
body.zh: 文本块和坐标可供程序读取。

body.en: The CLI works directly on a local archive.
body.zh: CLI 直接处理本地归档。

body.en: Read, metadata and rewrite share document structures.
body.zh: 读取、元信息与回写共用文档结构。

title.en: Run it on a complete example

note.en: Run read against the complete examples/sample.ofd archive and inspect its two pages of text blocks.
note.zh: 对完整的 examples/sample.ofd 归档运行 read，检查两页文本块。

steps.label: Recorded run
steps.body: Read the bundled synthetic two-page OFD document into text blocks and millimeter boundaries; no viewer rendering or standards certification.

body.en: Run read against the complete examples/sample.ofd archive and inspect its two pages of text blocks.
body.zh: 对完整的 examples/sample.ofd 归档运行 read，检查两页文本块。

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/ofdcli.git
cd ofdcli
go build ./cmd/ofdcli

limitations.en: Rewriting preserves the supported model, not every resource or visual detail in arbitrary OFD files. Keep the original and validate rewritten documents with your viewer.
limitations.zh: 回写保留的是支持的模型，不保证任意 OFD 的全部资源与视觉细节。请保留原件，并用实际查看器验证输出。

limitations.en: The sample is a synthetic document; successful parsing is not standards certification or legal validation.
limitations.zh: 样例为合成文档；解析成功不等于标准认证或法律有效性验证。

limitations.en: Template generation, electronic seals and the planned validate command are not implemented here.
limitations.zh: 模板生成、电子签章和计划中的 validate 命令尚未实现。

body.en: Automation needs document text and layout coordinates without opening an office application. A small CLI gives scripts a predictable input path and machine-readable result.
body.zh: 自动化通常需要文档文字和布局坐标，而不必打开办公应用。小型 CLI 为脚本提供明确输入路径与机器可读结果。

body.en: The reader opens the archive, resolves the OFD manifest and document/page XML chain, then constructs an OfdDocument. read projects text blocks to JSON; info summarizes structure; write serializes the supported model back into an OFD archive.
body.zh: 读取器打开归档，沿 OFD 清单、文档和页面 XML 建立 OfdDocument。read 将文本块投影成 JSON，info 汇总结构，write 将已支持的模型重新写成 OFD 容器。

body.en: The reader opens the archive, resolves the OFD manifest and document/page XML chain, then constructs an OfdDocument. read projects text blocks to JSON; info summarizes structure; write serializes the supported model back into an OFD archive.
body.zh: 读取器打开归档，沿 OFD 清单、文档和页面 XML 建立 OfdDocument。read 将文本块投影成 JSON，info 汇总结构，write 将已支持的模型重新写成 OFD 容器。

body.en: The following routes are implemented in the source. Choose the input that matches your task and keep the resulting artifact with your project.
body.zh: 以下路径已有源码实现。按任务选择输入，并把生成的结果与项目一起保存。

body.en: read takes an OFD path and optional --pretty. info supports --members/-m for archive members. write requires --input/-i and --output/-o; choose a distinct destination to keep the source intact. No daemon or office installation is needed.
body.zh: read 接收 OFD 路径和可选 --pretty；info 可用 --members/-m 查看归档成员；write 必须提供 --input/-i 与 --output/-o，建议使用不同输出路径保留原件。无需守护进程或办公软件。

body.en: The CLI exposes the following operations. Commands after the example use your own paths or identifiers.
body.zh: CLI 提供以下操作。示例之外的命令需要替换成你的文件路径或标识。

details.code:
go run ./cmd/ofdcli read examples/sample.ofd --pretty
go run ./cmd/ofdcli info examples/sample.ofd
go run ./cmd/ofdcli write -i examples/sample.ofd -o sample.normalized.ofd
